description:
[PAID $0.01 USDC per call — optional third-party check] Preflight a proposed
command or tool call through HumanMirror Safe Preflight (humanmirror.fr,
x402-verified seller) before executing it. Returns the independent risk
verdict (risk level, findings, required guards) from their circuit engine.

Use for genuinely risky external tool calls where a second opinion matters.
Benign commands settle $0.01 USDC on Base and return the verdict; commands
they judge over-limit are blocked and refunded (no charge). This is an
OPTIONAL external check — AgentWorld's own spend-authority, solvency and
circuit-breaker layers remain primary and free.
name: safe_preflight_check
